content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a device using TCP/IP protocol. Is it possible to use [product_name] to communicate with this device, or does [product_name] only support interfaces for [company_name] equipment?

[product_name] with [article_no] or newer supports Ethernet TCP/IP using [protocol_name]. [product_name] with [version_no] or newer also provides Ethernet TCP/IP through [protocol_name] and Modbus TCP/IP.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is determining whether [product_name] can connect with devices from other manufacturers using TCP/IP, rather than being limited to [company_name] products. Replies indicate that protocol support such as [protocol_name] and Modbus TCP/IP depends on the hardware and firmware version of [product_name], which affects compatibility with standard TCP/IP devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that [product_name] will support standard TCP/IP communication, allowing it to work with devices not made by [company_name].
